text: いちにち　いちぜんを　わすれずに！
note: いちにちいちぜん (一日一善, "one day, one good deed") is a well-known Japanese four-character motto. The English game expanded it into a rhyme, "a good deed a day brings happiness to stay".
claim: 一日一善 (ichinichi ichizen) is a set Japanese four-character phrase meaning to do one good deed every day.

check.quote: 「一日一善」は毎日1つは良いことをしようという意味を持つ四字熟語です。
